accessionNumber.sh: Identifying number for each artwork (not always unique)

additionalImages.sh: An array containing URLs to the additional images of an object in JPEG format

artistAlphaSort.sh: Used to sort artist names alphabetically

artistDisplayBio.sh: Nationality and life dates of an artist

artistDisplayName.sh: Artist name in the correct order for display

artistGender.sh: Gender of the artist (currently contains female designations only)

artistNationality.sh: National, geopolitical, cultural, or ethnic origins or affiliation of the creator

artistPrefix.sh: Describes the extent of creation or describes an attribution qualifier

artistRole.sh: Role of the artist related to the type of artwork or object that was created

artistSuffix.sh: Used to record complex information that qualifies the role of a constituent

city.sh: City where the artwork was created

classification.sh: General term describing the artwork type

constituents.sh: An array containing the constituents associated with an object

country.sh: Country where the artwork was created or found

county.sh: County where the artwork was created

creditLine.sh: Text acknowledging the source or origin of the artwork and the year the object was acquired

culture.sh: Information about the culture, or people from which an object was created

department.sh: Indicates The Met's curatorial department responsible for the artwork

dimensions.sh: Size of the artwork or object

dimensionsParsed.sh: Size of the artwork or object in centimeters, parsed

dynasty.sh: Dynasty under which an object was created

geographyType.sh: Qualifying information that describes the relationship of the place catalogued to the object

isHighlight.sh: When true indicates a popular and important artwork in the collection

isPublicDomain.sh: When true indicates an artwork in the Public Domain

isTimelineWork.sh: Whether the object is on the Timeline of Art History website

linkResource.sh: URL to object's page on metmuseum.org

locale.sh: Geographic location more specific than subregion

locus.sh: Geographic location that is less specific than locale

medium.sh: Refers to the materials that were used to create the artwork

objectBeginDate.sh: Machine readable date indicating the year the artwork was started to be created

objectDate.sh: Year, a span of years, or a phrase that describes the specific or approximate date when an artwork was designed or created

objectEndDate.sh: Machine readable date indicating the year the artwork was completed

objectID.sh: Identifying number for each artwork (unique, can be used as key field)

objectIDs.sh: An array containing the object ID of publicly-available objects

objectName.sh: Describes the physical type of the object

objectURL.sh: URL to object's page on metmuseum.org

period.sh: Time or time period when an object was created

portfolio.sh: A set of works created as a group or published as a series

primaryImage.sh: URL to the primary image of an object in JPEG format

primaryImageSmall.sh: URL to the lower-res primary image of an object in JPEG format

region.sh: Geographic location more specific than country

reign.sh: Reign of a monarch or ruler under which an object was created

rightsAndReproduction.sh: Credit line for artworks still under copyright

river.sh: River related to the origins of an artwork

state.sh: State or province where the artwork was created

subregion.sh: Geographic location more specific than Region

tags.sh: An array of subject keyword tags associated with the object

title.sh: Title, identifying phrase, or name given to a work of art

total.sh: The total number of publicly-available objects

objectIDs.sh: An array containing the object IDs of matching objects

total.sh: The total number of objects matching the search query

ratelimit.name: ratelimit
ratelimit.title: Rate limiting

retry.description: Automatic retry of transient failures with exponential backoff
retry.name: retry
retry.title: Retry

test.description: In-memory mock transport for testing without a live server
test.name: test
test.title: Test transport
